1131 is not a leap year (divisible by 3, not by 4).  
Days remaining in 1131 after 12-11: 20 days (Nov 12–30) + 31 (Dec) = 51 days.  
250 − 51 = 199 days into 1132.  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30 = 31+28+31+30+31+30 = 181 days (Jan–Jun).  
199 − 181 = 18 days into July → July 18, 1132.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1132-07-18
